post.summary: Log in as a patient, doctor, or admin using mobile number and password
post.description: The 'role' query parameter selects which login is performed (PATIENT, DOCTOR, or ADMIN). All three roles authenticate with the same mobileNumber + password payload shape.

post.summary: Log out the current user by invalidating the JWT

get.summary: Get available slots for a doctor on a given date
Get total available appointment slots for today across all hospitals and doctors
get.description: Aggregates today's remaining (unbooked) schedule slots for every active doctor in every hospital, with a per-hospital breakdown.

post.description: PATIENT books for self (patientId resolved from JWT if omitted). ADMIN books on behalf of a patient at their hospital.

get.summary: List appointments for the current user
get.description: PATIENT sees own appointments. DOCTOR sees own appointments. ADMIN sees appointments for their hospital.

patch.summary: Update the status of an appointment
patch.description: ADMIN and PATIENT (own appointments) can update status, e.g. cancel or complete.

get.summary: Get the current patient's own profile

put.summary: Update the current patient's own profile

get.description: PATIENT (own only). DOCTOR access requires an active appointment window with the patient. ADMIN has no PMR access.

get.summary: List PMR entries for a patient
get.description: PATIENT (own only). DOCTOR access requires an active appointment window with the patient. ADMIN has no PMR access.

post.summary: Add a PMR entry for a patient
post.description: DOCTOR only, and only during an active appointment window with the patient.

get.summary: List doctors, optionally filtered by hospital
Get a doctor's weekly recurring schedule

post.summary: Save a doctor's weekly recurring schedule
post.description: One schedule row per doctor per weekday (day_of_week 0=Mon ... 6=Sun).

get.summary: Get a doctor's calendar availability between two dates

post.description: PATIENT may upload PREVIOUS_RECORD type only (for themselves). ADMIN may upload any type for their hospital.

get.description: PATIENT sees own visible documents. ADMIN sees all for their hospital. DOCTOR sees patient-uploaded documents within the appointment time window.

get.summary: Get a SAS download URL for a document
Get notifications for the current user
Get unread notification count for the current user

patch.summary: Mark all notifications as read for the current user
Mark a single notification as read

AuthResponse.description: Authentication response containing the JWT and caller identity information.

token.description: JWT token issued after successful authentication.

hospitalId.description: Hospital identifier for doctor and admin logins; null for patients.

LoginRequest.description: Unified login payload for PATIENT, DOCTOR, and ADMIN roles (mobile number + password). The role itself is selected via the 'role' query parameter on the login endpoint.

PatientRegisterRequest.description: Request payload to register a new patient.

permanentIllness.description: Long-term / permanent illness details, if any.

AppointmentRequest.description: Request payload to book an appointment.

patientId.description: Patient identifier. Optional for patient self-booking because it is resolved from the JWT.

startTime.description: Appointment slot start time in local time.

isOffline.description: Whether the appointment is booked for an offline visit.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment was created.

AppointmentSummaryResponse.description: Compact appointment summary for list screens.

TodaySlotsSummaryResponse.description: Aggregate count of available appointment slots today across all hospitals and doctors.

HospitalSlotsSummary.description: Available slot count for a single hospital, part of the today-summary breakdown.

StatusUpdateRequest.description: Request payload to update an appointment status.

PmrEntryRequest.description: Request payload to add a PMR entry.

treatmentPlan.description: Treatment plan recommended by the doctor.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the PMR entry was created.
Timestamp when the PMR was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the PMR was last updated.

doctors.description: Active doctors available at the hospital.

isActive.description: Whether the doctor account is active.
Whether the doctor account is active.

CalendarDayResponse.description: Slot availability summary for a single calendar day.

totalSlots.description: Total slots configured for the day.

ScheduleRequest.description: Request payload to save a doctor's weekly schedule.

dayOfWeek.description: Day of week index where 0 is Monday and 6 is Sunday.

slotDurationMinutes.description: Duration of each slot in minutes.

dayOfWeek.description: Day of week index where 0 is Monday and 6 is Sunday.

slotDurationMinutes.description: Duration of each slot in minutes.

isActive.description: Whether the schedule entry is active.

age.description: Patient age in years, computed from dob.

permanentIllness.description: Long-term / permanent illness details, if any.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the patient was created.

PatientUpdateRequest.description: Request payload to update patient profile details.

age.description: Patient age in years, computed from dob.

isVisibleToPatient.description: Whether the patient can view the document.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the document was created.
Timestamp when the document was created.

DownloadUrlResponse.description: Time-limited download URL for a document.

downloadUrl.description: SAS URL for downloading the document.

expiresAt.description: Offset timestamp when the URL expires.

MarkReadResponse.description: Response confirming a notification read-state update.
